annotations.title: Rewrite your x402 API listing copy so agent routers match it, with an OpenAPI patch (AI)

description: For sellers of paid APIs. Same audit, then an open model rewrites the operationId, summary, description and tags of up to 5 operations (worst first) from your own listing only; sentences with numbers or links not in your listing, or hype words, are removed. Returns before/after with score and task-word coverage, and a JSON merge patch for openapi.json. AI-written, not human-reviewed. No openapi.json or no usable model output is not charged. PAID: $0.250 per call in USDC on Base via x402 over MCP, or from prepaid credits if this server is configured with an Authorization: Bearer tkc_... header (see payment_options).

origin.description: Host of the paid API to audit, e.g. api.example.com or https://api.example.com/v1/tool (a path is probed first). "sample" = a built-in example listing (no network request).

task.description: Optional: what a buyer would ask a router for, in their words (max 160 characters), e.g. "split text into an X thread"; the report shows which operation matches it best and which words are missing.
